skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Species Plantarum
skins.content: Test Collection/Species Plantarum. Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials carefully hand-sewn details. An extra custom-made multifunctional tool bag is included.
skins.quote: She's emitting the fragrance of countless flowers.

skins.name: Leisurely Afternoon
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Leisurely Afternoon. Home leisure style, relaxed and pleasing to the eye, graceful and cozy. Comes with a pair of adorable fitted slippers, for an afternoon completely free of cares wherever you are.
skins.quote: In this age, taking tea and reading until you're tired might just be a style of relaxation to make people envious.
